streaming.liveText: # NoteStore Implementation Specification## OverviewThis specification defines a minimal in-memory NoteStore implementation for the overlay-web-benchmark project. The implementation consists of two files only: the source module and its test file.## Project Context (Discovered via Exploration)- Project root: Empty scaffold with minimal configuration- package.json: "type": "module" - ES modules required- tsconfig.json: ES2022 target, strict mode enabled, moduleResolution: "Bundler"- Runtime: Bun with built-in bun:test framework- src/ directory: Exists but currently empty (verified via list_directory)- No existing TypeScript files: Greenfield implementation (verified via find_files)## Technical Requirements### File 1: src/note-store.tsMust export:1. Note interface with exact structure:      export interface Note {     id: string;     title: string;     done: boolean;     created_at: number;   }   2. NoteStore class with in-memory Map backing store:   - Private field: private notes = new Map<string, Note>()   - Method create(title: string): Note     - Trim whitespace from title using .trim()     - Throw Error if title is empty after trimming     - Generate ID using crypto.randomUUID() (available globally in Bun)     - Set done: false and created_at: Date.now()     - Store in Map and return the created Note   - Method get(id: string): Note | undefined     - Return Note from Map or undefined if not found   - Method list(): Note[]     - Return all notes as array     - Sort by created_at ascending (oldest first)     - Use .sort((a, b) => a.created_at - b.created_at)   - Method toggle(id: string): Note | undefined     - Find note by ID     - Flip the done boolean     - Return updated Note or undefined if not found   - Method remove(id: string): boolean     - Delete from Map using this.notes.delete(id)     - Return true if deleted, false if not found### File 2: src/note-store.test.tsMust use import { test, expect } from "bun:test" and cover:1. create returns a complete Note: Verify all fields (id, title, done, created_at) are present and correct2. empty title throws: Verify Error is thrown for empty/whitespace-only titles3. list preserves creation order: Create multiple notes, verify sorted by created_at ascending4. toggle flips done: Create note, toggle, verify done changed from false to true5. remove deletes successfully: Remove note, verify get() returns undefined## Constraints (from Codebase Exploration)- ES Modules only: package.json has "type": "module" - must use import/export syntax- Strict TypeScript: tsconfig.json has "strict": true - no implicit any, proper typing required- Bun runtime: crypto.randomUUID() available globally, no import needed- Two files only: User explicitly restricted to src/note-store.ts and src/note-store.test.ts- No README: Despite readme_policy preference, user explicitly said no README files## Design Decisions- In-memory Map: Chosen for O(1) lookups by ID, simple implementation- Immutable updates: toggle modifies in-place for simplicity (per requirements)- Timestamp precision: Date.now() returns milliseconds, sufficient for ordering- UUID v4: crypto.randomUUID() generates RFC 4122 compliant UUIDs- Error handling: Throw Error (not custom error class) for empty title per minimal requirement## Code Comments RequirementPer active preference code_comments, add comments explaining:- The purpose of the NoteStore class- The trimming and validation logic in create()- The sorting logic in list()
